# Font fixture

`LiberationSans-Regular.ttf` is an **unmodified** Liberation Sans font, copied from
the development system's `fonts-liberation` package. It is used only for tests and
is not bundled in the application.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/liberationfonts/liberation-fonts>
- License and copyright notices: `LICENSE-Liberation.txt` (SIL OFL 1.1)
- SHA-256: `4659bc0c58c5028dd488ec928d41d9265db43d9b669fc14ca8b0832daca7b144`

The fixture exercises real cmap, outlines and OpenType data without relying on
fonts installed on CI machines.
